IC1: Histologically confirmed locally advanced gastric (primary endpoint includes proximal  and mid-body stomach) [OR] or esophagogastric adenocarcinoma [OR]; distal gastric (antral) adenocarcinomas are eligible for enrolment but will not be included in the primary analysis
IC2: Locally advanced disease [AND] as determined by endoscopic ultrasound (EUS) stage > primary tumor (T) 3 and/or any T, lymph nodes (N)+ disease without metastatic disease (Mx)
IC3: All patients must have diagnostic laparoscopy with diagnostic washings for cytology; both cytology positive [OR] and negative patients are eligible for enrolment, but only cytology negative patients will be included in the primary analyses; gross peritoneal disease is not eligible
IC4: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status =< 1
IC5: Eligible for surgery with curative intent
IC9: Total bilirubin < 1.5 x upper limit of normal
IC10: Serum glutamic oxaloacetic transaminase (SGOT) and serum glutamate pyruvate transaminase (SGPT) < 2.5 x upper limit of normal for patients [NOT] without liver metastases OR SGOT and SGPT < 5 x upper limit of normal for patients with liver metastases
IC11: Creatinine =< 1.5 x upper limit of normal
IC12: Measurable or non-measurable disease by Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumor (RECIST) 1.1 will be allowed
IC13: Women of child-bearing potential and men must agree to use adequate contraception (hormonal or barrier method of birth control; abstinence) prior to study entry and for the duration of study participation, up until 30 days after final study treatment; should a woman become pregnant or suspect that she is pregnant while participating in this study, she should inform her treating physician immediately
IC14: Patients taking substrates, inhibitors, or inducers of cytochrome P450, family 3, subfamily A, polypeptide 4 (CYP3A4) should be encouraged to switch to alternative drugs whenever possible, given the potential for drug-drug interactions with irinotecan
